decision: Keep the measured background-fetch path. The 20,000-file control and fetch timing envelopes intersect within each index preparation. In the later optimized cohort, the same edit appeared sooner in both the control and fetch trials after verification and refresh of the copied index. The row-held triplet establishes staging visibility during a transport wait.

debug.profile: Rust dev with production frontend assets

optimized.profile: Rust release with production frontend assets
optimized.recipe: Use the drive-build frontend and Cargo recipe with --release on cargo build. Measure target/drive-build/release/trunk under src-tauri.

builds.sourceProvenance: The native samples used fifth-sweep development binaries. Each manifest carries the measured binary SHA-256. The runner checked the binary device, inode, size, mtime and ctime before each trial and after the cohort.

applicationSource.reproduction: In a disposable checkout of referenceCommit, apply patchFromReference as a unified diff before building. The patch restores the measured debug source's mutex guard scopes, a test setup and a Rust documentation comment. Verify the two source digests below. The other 315 files in the debug source inventory matched the reference.
applicationSource.optimizedSourceEvidence: The optimized binary was built in the same checkout after the debug source inventory, before the recorded edits to these two files. The same sources are inferred for that build. Its binary SHA-256 was verified for both optimized cohorts. No separate optimized source inventory was captured.

machine.webview: WKWebView in the native drive app. The trial manifests omit the exact macOS and WebKit build numbers.

fixture.largeFixture: E16's 20,000-path fast-import tree with one initial commit. The controller copies the disposable fixture with /bin/cp -cRp, preserves its index, and restores the chosen file to its HEAD bytes before app startup.
fixture.smallFixture: 30 paths generated in repo_fixture.py with the same E16 file template.
fixture.edit: Append the case's serial-specific line to src/d000/f00007.txt. Reuse the same fixture copy per cohort, restore the original file bytes and remove the added tracking and bare-remote branch after each changed case.

cases.control: No fetch invocation and zero HTTP requests.
cases.unchanged: Fetch origin with its baseline refs.
cases.changed: Fetch origin after its bare repo acquires refs/heads/trunk440-incoming at a distinct empty child commit for this trial. The child object is absent from the measured worktree's database before opening the app.

fixture.indexStatScope: The witness records matching worktree inode, ctime and mtime after refresh, with unchanged NUL-delimited git ls-files --stage records. Check index stat fields against the worktree that the app will open, including after copying a checkout. Any explicit refresh is part of disposable fixture preparation.

protocol.startup: New macOS drive instance and scratch preferences per trial. Disable periodic fetch and graph Diff statistics, show SHA and use flat staging. Subscribe before opening. Wait for the first repo-changed event for this repository with empty paths, no graph revision and neither the refs_only nor the command_completed flag. Watcher catch-up and other unscoped changes share that payload. After an independent clean get_status reply, arm on the exact baseline graph commit and origin/main with empty staging.
protocol.worker: Invoke git_fetch_background with intervalMs: 0 through real Tauri IPC. The cohort reaches the worker directly.
protocol.transport: Serve a disposable bare origin via Git http-backend on 127.0.0.1. Fixture processes use isolated Git config and the app and worker are sandboxed to the ephemeral local port. Wait for receipt of the smart HTTP advertisement GET, then withhold it before the backend starts. For write release, unblock after open/append/close. For row release, unblock after the controller receives the observer's exact row acknowledgement. The bounds require GET receipt <= write start <= write end <= release <= backend start.
protocol.correctRow: First page MutationObserver observation of exactly one Unstaged row with the exact path and M marker, and zero Staged rows.
protocol.refReady: First page MutationObserver observation with both the exact incoming remote branch title and text in the expanded Remote section, and for its graph row, exact summary and a displayed SHA of at least seven characters that prefixes the incoming commit OID. Retain the first timestamp for each separately.
protocol.fetchIpcReturn: When the page's Tauri invoke promise resolves with the fetch report. This endpoint includes delivery of the reply.
protocol.gitOracle: Compare exact edited file bytes, raw .git/index SHA-256, target stage entry, HEAD symbolic ref and OID, all refs including symbolic targets, and exact one-path porcelain v1 status. In the changed case the local refs gain only the expected origin tracking ref at the new OID and the server must process an upload-pack POST. Bare refs remain equal to their pre-trial snapshot. Control makes zero HTTP requests. Fetch reports must be successful with the expected per-origin outcome, separate from the aggregate outcome and graph rebuild count.
protocol.processAdmission: Trials ran serially under the native diff-scroll lock. The classifier joins process executable and argument inventories at entry and exit to screen for competing build/test processes. All 60 endpoint inventories admitted their samples. Each receipt records phase timestamps, classifier verdict, competing matches and the row count and SHA-256 of the captured executable inventory. Arguments are used by the classifier in memory. Inventory digests identify the original captures.
protocol.settlement: The controller waits for fetch IPC and the required DOM endpoints, then takes Git snapshots. Remaining startup work and global reader, watcher and graph settlement are unobservable through this route.

timing.units: Host receipts use monotonic nanoseconds. Page receipts use performance.now() milliseconds. Duration bounds and summaries are in milliseconds.
timing.clockCalibration: Each trial brackets three page clock reads before the timed action and three after the observed endpoints with host monotonic reads. Assuming a constant offset in the window, intersect the six offset brackets, each expanded by 1 ms on both sides for page clock quantization at calibration. Allow another 1 ms on each side for the endpoint clock read.
timing.differences: For an endpoint host bracket, subtract write end from its lower bound and write start from its upper bound. For gate-relative bounds subtract the same exact release timestamp from both. The reported waiting time is the host interval from first advertisement receipt to release, including any controller handoff. Same-page differences retain the observed quantized values.
timing.aggregation: Each envelope spans the smallest lower and largest upper bound over a condition. A comparison between preparations subtracts the largest refreshed upper bound from the smallest copied lower bound, even across trials. These are observed interval separations at this fixture and build.

sameOptimizedBinaryComparison.interpretation: The before-refresh witness has copied index stat metadata for a different inode and ctime. Refresh aligns both, keeps staged entries byte-for-byte, and precedes a large reduction in the observed timings, including the no-fetch control. The comparison covers the generated fixture and batches run in sequence. It leaves the cause of waits in users' established worktrees and their operation histories open.

limitations: Per-phase inventories can miss activity between the two snapshots. CPU time and utilization over the window, memory and allocations, storage I/O, energy and system pressure were unmeasured.
Observers timestamp DOM and IPC. Paint and presented frames, input delay and global settlement were unmeasured.

Direct background IPC with one checked origin bypasses scheduler cadence. The server is local and deliberately gated. Naturally unheld fetch, manual fetch, live transport, repeated saves, other repo sizes beyond the 30-file smoke and 20,000-file cohort, and histories with other ref topologies or worktree states are outside this measurement.
The stat check witnesses one path. The procedure refreshes the entire disposable index via Git. The recordings do not profile the shape or cost of the readers within a timing interval.

excludedRuns.reason: Superseded by the row-held triplet with explicit pre-arm watcher and clean-status observations.

Pre-arm observations were incomplete. The old oracle rejected an unchanged remote when the aggregate report was changed after a graph rebuild. The corrected oracle uses the per-remote outcome and exact Git refs.

observations.error: unexpected report: {'graph_error': None, 'graph_rebuilds': 1, 'outcome': 'changed', 'remotes': [{'error_code': None, 'error_message': None, 'last_attempt_ms': 1795272620794, 'last_success_ms': 1795272620794, 'metadata_error_code': None, 'metadata_error_message': None, 'outcome': 'unchanged', 'remote': 'origin', 'retry_at_ms': None}]}

additionalScope: The Git-only fixture smoke is a transport/oracle check without native timings. The admitted 30-file triplet is a row-before-release demonstration, outside the 20,000-file timing comparison.

replay.sourceLayout: Unpack the sources.original map as three files directly in a child of .boris under the checkout root. For release-refreshed, overwrite only run.py in a second such directory with sources.statWitness.run.py. Preserve trailing newlines. Each run output directory must be new and inside its runner's directory.
replay.imports: Both runners import repo_fixture.py and load observe.js alongside run.py. From scripts/diff-scroll they import process_admission.measurement_window and run.evaluate, request, save and until. The diff-scroll modules also import analysis and fixture there. From scripts/interaction-performance they import processes.stop_app.
replay.portability: Requires macOS and Python 3.11 or later, Git with git http-backend, the checkout's drive build and helper modules, and a quiet serial slot. Generate the large fixture with E16's saved generator into a fresh no-remote repository and check out main. The exact runner expects /tmp/t489/r20000. For a different disposable path, adjust E16_SOURCE and its resolved-path check in the unpacked repo_fixture.py, record the modified hash and verify manifest.files = 20000 so a missing large fixture cannot silently substitute the 30-file case.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Serial I18 tracked-save pilot. Use --fixture-smoke for the non-native check."""

import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from threading import Timer
import time

from repo_fixture import (
    BRANCH, DEADLINE, GIT, TARGET, TRACKING, add_branch, environment, git, local_remote,
    need, network_profile, prepare, refs, snapshot, verify, write_edit,
)

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
TRUNK = HERE.parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(TRUNK / "scripts/diff-scroll"))
from process_admission import measurement_window
from run import evaluate, request, save, until

sys.path.insert(0, str(TRUNK / "scripts/interaction-performance"))
from processes import stop_app

CASES = ("control", "unchanged", "changed")
REMOTE_SECTION = '[data-testid="branch-section-remote"]'
REMOTE_HEADER = f'{REMOTE_SECTION} [data-testid="branch-section-header"]'
PAGE_ROW = '[data-testid="staging-unstaged-section"]'
SANDBOX = "/usr/bin/sandbox-exec"


def install_observer(directory, spec):
    until(directory, f'document.querySelector({json.dumps(PAGE_ROW)}) && '
          f'document.querySelector({json.dumps(REMOTE_HEADER)}) && true')
    main_branch = f'{REMOTE_SECTION} [title="main"]'
    evaluate(directory, f'document.querySelector({json.dumps(main_branch)}) || '
             f'document.querySelector({json.dumps(REMOTE_HEADER)}).click()')
    until(directory, f'document.querySelector({json.dumps(main_branch)}) && true')
    return evaluate(directory, f'({(HERE / "observe.js").read_text()})({json.dumps(spec)})')


def prepare_page(directory, spec, readiness):
    path = json.dumps(spec["repo"])
    evaluate(directory, f'''(async () => {{
      const tauri = window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__;
      let report;
      window.trunk440CatchUp = new Promise((resolve) => {{ report = resolve; }});
      await tauri.invoke('plugin:event|listen', {{
        event: 'repo-changed', target: {{kind: 'Any'}},
        handler: tauri.transformCallback(({{payload}}) => {{
          if (payload.repo === {path} && payload.paths.length === 0 &&
              !payload.graph_revision && !payload.command_completed && !payload.refs_only) {{
            report({{atMs: performance.now(), payload}});
          }}
        }}),
      }});
      return true;
    }})()''')
    evaluate(directory, '''(() => {
      void window.__trunkDrive.click('button', 'Open Repository').catch(console.error);
      return true;
    })()''')
    readiness["picker"] = evaluate(directory, "window.__trunkDrive.picker()")
    evaluate(directory, f"window.__trunkDrive.pick({path})")
    readiness["watcher_catch_up"] = evaluate(directory, "window.trunk440CatchUp")
    readiness["clean_status_probe"] = evaluate(directory, f'''(async () => {{
      const tauri = window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__;
      const startedMs = performance.now();
      const status = await tauri.invoke('get_status', {{path: {path}}});
      return {{startedMs, completeMs: performance.now(), status}};
    }})()''')
    status = readiness["clean_status_probe"]["status"]
    need(not (status["unstaged"] or status["staged"] or status["conflicted"]),
         "startup status probe returned changes")
    readiness["remaining_startup_pending"] = "Unobservable in the stock drive build"


def clock_samples(directory):
    readings = []
    for _ in range(3):
        before = time.monotonic_ns()
        page_ms = evaluate(directory, "performance.now()")
        readings.append([before, page_ms, time.monotonic_ns()])
    return readings


def derive_timings(evidence):
    # Account for up to 1 ms of WebKit clock quantization on each observation.
    samples = evidence["clock_before"] + evidence["clock_after"]
    low = max(before - page * 1_000_000 for before, page, _ in samples)
    high = min(after - page * 1_000_000 for _, page, after in samples)
    need(low <= high + 2_000_000, "host/page clock brackets disagree")
    low, high = low - 1_000_000, high + 1_000_000

    def host_bounds(page_ms):
        if page_ms is None:
            return None
        return [page_ms * 1_000_000 + low - 1_000_000,
                page_ms * 1_000_000 + high + 1_000_000]

    def delta(endpoint, start, end):
        return None if endpoint is None else [(endpoint[0] - end) / 1_000_000,
                                              (endpoint[1] - start) / 1_000_000]

    page = evidence["page"]
    write_start, write_end = evidence["write_monotonic_ns"]
    row = host_bounds(page["rowMs"])
    completion = host_bounds(page["fetchCompleteMs"])
    readiness = host_bounds(page["refReadyMs"])
    evidence["calibrated_host_bounds_ns"] = {
        "file_row": row, "fetch_ipc_return": completion, "ref_ready": readiness,
    }
    evidence["write_to_correct_row_ms_bounds"] = delta(row, write_start, write_end)
    evidence["write_to_ref_ready_ms_bounds"] = delta(readiness, write_start, write_end)
    evidence["overlap"] = "no fetch in control"
    if completion is None:
        return

    arrived = evidence["advertisement"]["request_ns"]
    evidence["fetch_ipc_elapsed_ms"] = page["fetchCompleteMs"] - page["fetchStartMs"]
    released = evidence["barrier_release_ns"]
    if released is not None:
        backend = evidence["advertisement"]["backend_start_ns"]
        need(arrived <= write_start <= write_end <= released <= backend,
             "timestamps do not prove the entire write occurred under the barrier")
        evidence["overlap"] = "proved: complete write during blocked advertisement"
        evidence["imposed_wait_ms"] = (released - arrived) / 1_000_000
        evidence["release_to_fetch_ipc_return_ms_bounds"] = delta(completion, released, released)
        evidence["release_to_ref_ready_ms_bounds"] = delta(readiness, released, released)
        if evidence["release_mode"] == "row":
            evidence["row_observed_before_release_by_handoff"] = True
    elif arrived <= write_start and completion[0] >= write_end:
        evidence["overlap"] = "proved: complete write during pending fetch IPC"
    else:
        evidence["overlap"] = "unproved: fetch may have completed before the write finished"


def check_page(page, case, command):
    need(page["fetchError"] is None, f'fetch rejected: {page["fetchError"]}')
    if case != "control":
        report = page["fetchReport"]
        need(report and report["graph_error"] is None, f"invalid fetch report: {report}")
        if command == "git_fetch_background":
            allowed = {"changed", "unchanged"} if case == "unchanged" else {"changed"}
            need(report["outcome"] in allowed and len(report["remotes"]) == 1,
                 f"unexpected report: {report}")
            remote = report["remotes"][0]
            need(remote["remote"] == "origin" and remote["outcome"] == case and
                 remote["error_code"] is None and remote["metadata_error_code"] is None,
                 f"unexpected remote result: {remote}")
    need(page["fileRowCorrect"], "final staging row is incorrect")
    changed = case == "changed"
    need(page["incomingBranchCount"] == int(changed), "incorrect final remote branch")
    need(page["incomingGraphCount"] == int(changed), "incorrect final graph row")
    if case == "control":
        need(page["fetchStartMs"] is None and page["fetchCompleteMs"] is None, "control invoked fetch")


def wait_socket(directory, app):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 8
    while not (directory / "listening").is_file():
        need(app.poll() is None and time.monotonic() < deadline, "drive socket never became ready")
        time.sleep(0.025)


def native_sample(args, output, repo, remote, base, head, serial, case, incoming, summary):
    evidence = {
        "case": case, "serial": serial, "command": args.command if case != "control" else None,
        "release_mode": args.release, "incoming_oid": incoming,
        "settlement": "Unobservable. Git fetch IPC return and correct DOM endpoints are recorded.",
    }
    hold = case != "control" and args.release != "none"
    with local_remote(remote, hold=hold) as server, tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(
        prefix="t440d-", dir="/tmp"
    ) as private:
        directory = Path(private).resolve()
        data = directory / "data"
        data.mkdir()
        save(data / "trunk-prefs.json", {
            "column_visibility": {"diff": False, "sha": True},
            "tree_view_enabled": False, "fetch_interval_ms": 0,
        })
        git(repo, "remote", "set-url", "origin", server.url)
        evidence["before"] = snapshot(repo)
        evidence["remote_before_refs"] = refs(remote)
        need(evidence["before"]["porcelain"] == [], "dirty starting fixture")
        spec = {"repo": str(repo), "path": TARGET, "branch": BRANCH, "baseOid": head,
                "baseSummary": git(repo, "show", "-s", "--format=%s", "HEAD").decode().strip(),
                "incomingOid": incoming, "incomingSummary": summary}
        env = dict(environment(), TRUNK_DRIVE_DIR=str(directory), TRUNK_DATA_DIR=str(data))
        with (output / "app.log").open("wb") as log:
            app = subprocess.Popen([SANDBOX, "-p", network_profile(server.server_port), str(args.binary)],
                                   env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=log, stderr=log)
            watchdog = Timer(13, app.kill)
            watchdog.start()
            try:
                wait_socket(directory, app)
                evidence["startup"] = {}
                prepare_page(directory, spec, evidence["startup"])
                evidence["arm"] = install_observer(directory, spec)
                evidence["startup"]["baseline_graph_and_empty_staging_verified"] = True
                evidence["arm_receipt_ns"] = time.monotonic_ns()
                with measurement_window(output):
                    evidence["clock_before"] = clock_samples(directory)
                    if case != "control":
                        evaluate(directory, f'window.trunk440.start({json.dumps(args.command)})')
                        need(server.advertised.wait(DEADLINE), "no fetch advertisement reached the bare remote")
                    edit, started, finished = write_edit(repo, base, serial)
                    evidence["write_monotonic_ns"] = [started, finished]
                    evidence["expected_worktree_hex"] = edit.hex()
                    if hold and args.release == "row":

                    evidence["clock_after"] = clock_samples(directory)

                check_page(evidence["page"], case, args.command)
                evidence["advertisement"] = server.advertisement
                evidence["barrier_release_ns"] = server.release_ns
                evidence["after"] = snapshot(repo)
                evidence["remote_after_refs"] = refs(remote)

            except BaseException as error:
                evidence["verdict"] = "inconclusive"
                evidence["error"] = str(error)
                server.release()
                if app.poll() is None and (directory / "listening").exists():

                evidence["http"] = server.requests
                evidence["advertisement"] = server.advertisement
                evidence["barrier_release_ns"] = server.release_ns

                    stop_app(app, lambda: request(directory, {"op": "quit"}))
                finally:

                    watchdog.join()

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="t440smoke-", dir="/tmp") as scratch:
        root = Path(scratch).resolve()

            changed = case == "changed"
            incoming, _ = add_branch(repo, remote, serial, head) if changed else (None, None)
            before = snapshot(repo)
            with local_remote(remote, hold=case != "control") as server:
                if case == "control":
                    edit, _, _ = write_edit(repo, base, serial)
                else:
                    git(repo, "remote", "set-url", "origin", server.url)
                    with subprocess.Popen([SANDBOX, "-p", network_profile(server.server_port),
                                            GIT, "-C", str(repo), "fetch", "--all"],
                                           env=environment(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                           stderr=subprocess.PIPE) as fetch:
                        try:
                            need(server.advertised.wait(DEADLINE), "smoke fetch did not reach advertisement")
                            need(fetch.poll() is None and not server.released.is_set(), "fetch not held")
                            need(refs(repo) == before["refs"], "ref shown while response held")
                            edit, _, _ = write_edit(repo, base, serial)
                            need(fetch.poll() is None, "fetch finished before gate release")
                            server.release()
                            _, stderr = fetch.communicate(timeout=DEADLINE)
                            need(fetch.returncode == 0, f"Git smoke fetch failed: {stderr.decode()}")
                        finally:
                            server.release()

                need(not any("error" in entry for entry in server.requests), f"HTTP smoke failed: {server.requests}")
                need(bool(server.requests) == (case != "control"), "unexpected smoke HTTP count")
                if changed:
                    need(any(r["method"] == "POST" for r in server.requests), "no Git pack negotiation")
            (repo / TARGET).write_bytes(base)
            print(f"{case}: fixture, local Git transport, exact bytes/index/refs verified")
    print("No app launched and no performance samples recorded.")


def run(args):
    args.binary = args.binary.resolve(strict=True)
    args.output = args.output.resolve()
    need(args.output.is_relative_to(HERE), "output must be inside the ignored pilot directory")
    args.output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    order = list(CASES) if args.blocks == 1 else [
        *CASES, "unchanged", "changed", "control", "changed", "control", "unchanged",
    ]
    with Path("/tmp/trunk-native-diff-scroll.lock").open("a") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="t440i18-", dir="/tmp") as scratch:
            root = Path(scratch).resolve()
            repo, remote, base, head, count, source = prepare(root, args.small)
            def binary_identity():
                stat = args.binary.stat()
                return stat.st_dev, stat.st_ino, stat.st_size, stat.st_mtime_ns, stat.st_ctime_ns

            binary_stat = binary_identity()
            with args.binary.open("rb") as binary:
                binary_hash = hashlib.file_digest(binary, "sha256").hexdigest()
            save(args.output / "manifest.json", {
                "binary": str(args.binary), "sha256": binary_hash, "fixture_source": source,
                "files": count, "head_oid": head, "edit_path": TARGET, "order": order,
                "command": args.command, "release": args.release, "git": GIT,
                "git_version": git(root, "--version").decode().strip(),
                "script_sha256": {name: hashlib.sha256((HERE / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                                  for name in ("run.py", "repo_fixture.py", "observe.js")},
            })
            for serial, case in enumerate(order, 1):
                need(binary_identity() == binary_stat, "binary changed during the pilot")
                sample_dir = args.output / f"{serial:02d}-{case}"
                sample_dir.mkdir()
                incoming, summary = (None, None)
                if case == "changed":
                    incoming, summary = add_branch(repo, remote, serial, head)
                result = native_sample(args, sample_dir, repo, remote, base, head,
                                       serial, case, incoming, summary)
                (repo / TARGET).write_bytes(base)
                if incoming:
                    git(repo, "update-ref", "-d", TRACKING, incoming)
                    git(remote, "update-ref", "-d", f"refs/heads/{BRANCH}", incoming)
                print(json.dumps({"sample": sample_dir.name, "overlap": result["overlap"],
                                  "row_ms_bounds": result["write_to_correct_row_ms_bounds"]}), flush=True)
            need(binary_identity() == binary_stat, "binary changed during the last sample")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--fixture-smoke", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--small", action="store_true", help="use the 30-file E16-style fixture")
    parser.add_argument("--binary", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--blocks", type=int, choices=(1, 3), default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--command", choices=("git_fetch_background", "git_fetch"),
                        default="git_fetch_background")
    parser.add_argument("--release", choices=("write", "row", "none"), default="write")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.fixture_smoke:
        need(args.binary is None and args.output is None, "smoke does not launch a drive binary")
        smoke()
        return
    if not args.binary or not args.output:
        parser.error("native pilot requires --binary and --output")
    if args.blocks == 3 and args.release == "row":
        parser.error("row-held fairness is limited to one block")
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, lambda _signal, _frame: sys.exit(143))
    run(args)

    main()

"""Disposable E16 fixture and a single-request barrier for real Git smart HTTP."""

from contextlib import contextmanager
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
from threading import Event, Thread
import time

TARGET = "src/d000/f00007.txt"
BRANCH = "trunk440-incoming"
TRACKING = f"refs/remotes/origin/{BRANCH}"
LOCAL_REF = "refs/remotes/origin/main"
E16_SOURCE = Path("/tmp/t489/r20000")
GIT = shutil.which("git")
DEADLINE = 8


def need(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def environment():
    env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
           if not key.startswith("GIT_") and not key.lower().endswith("_proxy")}
    return dict(env, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=os.devnull,
                GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1", GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT="0", GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0",
                GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL="file:http", NO_PROXY="127.0.0.1,localhost")


def git(repo, *args, data=None):
    return subprocess.run([GIT, "-C", str(repo), *args], input=data,
                          env=environment(), check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30).stdout


def status(repo):
    return git(repo, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")


def refs(repo):
    return [line.split(" ", 2) for line in git(
        repo, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname) %(objectname) %(symref)"
    ).decode().splitlines()]


def snapshot(repo):
    target = repo / TARGET
    return {
        "worktree_hex": target.read_bytes().hex(),
        "index_sha256": hashlib.sha256((repo / ".git/index").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "index_entry": git(repo, "ls-files", "--stage", "--", TARGET).decode().rstrip("\n"),
        "head_oid": git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip(),
        "head_ref": git(repo, "symbolic-ref", "HEAD").decode().strip(),
        "refs": refs(repo),
        "porcelain": status(repo).decode().split("\0")[:-1],
    }


def prepare(root, small):
    repo = root / "repo"
    if not small and E16_SOURCE.is_dir():
        need(E16_SOURCE.resolve() == Path("/private/tmp/t489/r20000"), "unexpected E16 path")
        subprocess.run(["/bin/cp", "-cRp", str(E16_SOURCE), str(repo)], check=True, timeout=90)
        source = str(E16_SOURCE)
    else:
        repo.mkdir()
        git(repo, "init", "-q", "--template=", "--initial-branch=main")
        fixture = [b"commit refs/heads/main\ncommitter Fixture <fixture@example.invalid> "
                   b"1700000000 +0000\ndata 7\ninitial\n"]
        for number in range(30):
            body = f"file {number}\n".encode() * 20
            fixture.extend([f"M 100644 inline src/d000/f{number:05d}.txt\ndata {len(body)}\n".encode(),
                            body, b"\n"])
        git(repo, "fast-import", "--quiet", data=b"".join(fixture) + b"\n")
        git(repo, "read-tree", "--reset", "-u", "HEAD")
        source = "generated E16-style 30-file fixture"

    need((repo / ".git").resolve() == repo / ".git", "gitdir escapes fixture")
    need(not (repo / ".git/objects/info/alternates").exists(), "shared objects in fixture")
    target = repo / TARGET
    need(target.resolve() == target, "target escapes fixture")
    need(git(repo, "remote") == b"", "fixture has existing remotes")
    need(status(repo) in (b"", f" M {TARGET}\0".encode()), "unexpected original fixture changes")
    base = git(repo, "show", f"HEAD:{TARGET}")
    if target.read_bytes() != base:
        target.write_bytes(base)
    need(status(repo) == b"", "fixture is not clean after restoration")

    git(repo, "config", "core.hooksPath", os.devnull)
    git(repo, "config", "core.fsmonitor", "false")
    git(repo, "config", "http.proxy", "")
    remote = root / "origin.git"
    git(root, "clone", "--bare", "--no-hardlinks", "--template=", str(repo), str(remote))
    head = git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()
    git(repo, "remote", "add", "origin", remote.as_uri())
    git(repo, "update-ref", LOCAL_REF, head)
    git(repo, "symbolic-ref", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD", LOCAL_REF)
    count = len(git(repo, "ls-files", "-z").split(b"\0")) - 1
    need(count == (30 if source.startswith("generated") else 20_000),
         f"unexpected fixture size {count}")
    return repo, remote, base, head, count, source


def add_branch(repo, remote, serial, head):
    tree = git(remote, "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}").decode().strip()
    identity = f"Fixture <fixture@example.invalid> {1700000060 + serial} +0000"
    summary = f"trunk440 incoming {serial:02d}"
    content = (f"tree {tree}\nparent {head}\nauthor {identity}\n"
               f"committer {identity}\n\n{summary}\n").encode()
    oid = git(remote, "hash-object", "-w", "-t", "commit", "--stdin", data=content).decode().strip()
    need(subprocess.run([GIT, "-C", str(repo), "cat-file", "-e", oid], env=environment(),
                        timeout=5, capture_output=True).returncode == 1,
         "incoming commit is already present locally")
    git(remote, "update-ref", f"refs/heads/{BRANCH}", oid)
    return oid, summary


def write_edit(repo, base, serial):
    edit = base + f"trunk440 tracked edit {serial:02d}\n".encode()
    started = time.monotonic_ns()
    with (repo / TARGET).open("ab") as output:
        output.write(edit[len(base):])
    return edit, started, time.monotonic_ns()


def verify(before, after, edit, incoming):
    expected = {
        **before,
        "worktree_hex": edit.hex(),
        "porcelain": [f" M {TARGET}"],
        "refs": sorted(before["refs"] + ([[TRACKING, incoming, ""]] if incoming else [])),
    }
    disagreements = {field: {"expected": value, "observed": after[field]}
                     for field, value in expected.items() if after[field] != value}
    need(not disagreements, f"Git oracle disagrees on {disagreements}")


class Remote(HTTPServer):
    def __init__(self, remote, hold):
        super().__init__(("127.0.0.1", 0), Backend)
        self.git_directory = remote
        self.requests = []
        self.advertised = Event()
        self.released = Event()
        self.hold = hold
        self.advertisement = None
        self.release_ns = None

    @property
    def url(self):
        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server_port}/origin.git"

    def release(self):
        if self.hold and not self.released.is_set():
            self.release_ns = time.monotonic_ns()
            self.released.set()

    def get_request(self):
        connection, address = super().get_request()
        connection.settimeout(DEADLINE)
        return connection, address


class Backend(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        self.serve_pack()

    def do_POST(self):
        self.serve_pack()

    def log_message(self, *_args):
        pass

    def serve_pack(self):
        path, _, query = self.path.partition("?")
        entry = {"method": self.command, "path": self.path, "request_ns": time.monotonic_ns()}
        self.server.requests.append(entry)
        try:
            if (self.command, path, query) == ("GET", "/origin.git/info/refs", "service=git-upload-pack"):
                if self.server.advertisement is None:
                    self.server.advertisement = entry
                    self.server.advertised.set()
                    if self.server.hold:
                        need(self.server.released.wait(DEADLINE), "advertisement barrier timed out")
            else:
                need((self.command, path, query) == ("POST", "/origin.git/git-upload-pack", ""),
                     "unexpected HTTP request")
            size = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
            need(0 <= size <= 65_536 and not self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding"),
                 "unexpected request body")
            protocol = self.headers.get("Git-Protocol", "")
            need(protocol in ("", "version=1", "version=2"), "unexpected Git protocol")
            env = dict(environment(), GIT_PROJECT_ROOT=str(self.server.git_directory.parent),
                       GIT_HTTP_EXPORT_ALL="1", PATH_INFO=path, QUERY_STRING=query,
                       REQUEST_METHOD=self.command, CONTENT_LENGTH=str(size),
                       CONTENT_TYPE=self.headers.get("Content-Type", ""), GIT_PROTOCOL=protocol)
            body = self.rfile.read(size)
            entry["backend_start_ns"] = time.monotonic_ns()
            response = subprocess.run([GIT, "http-backend"], env=env, input=body,
                                      capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=DEADLINE).stdout
            entry["backend_finish_ns"] = time.monotonic_ns()
            headers, body = response.split(b"\r\n\r\n", 1)
            fields = [line.decode("ascii").split(": ", 1) for line in headers.split(b"\r\n")]
            need(not any(key.lower() in ("status", "location") for key, _ in fields),
                 "Git HTTP backend returned a non-default status or redirect")
            self.send_response(200)
            for key, value in fields:
                self.send_header(key, value)
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)
            self.wfile.flush()
            entry["reply_sent_ns"] = time.monotonic_ns()
        except Exception as error:
            entry["error"] = str(error)
            self.close_connection = True


@contextmanager
def local_remote(remote, hold):
    with Remote(remote, hold) as server:
        thread = Thread(target=server.serve_forever, kwargs={"poll_interval": 0.05})
        thread.start()
        try:
            yield server
        finally:
            server.release()
            server.shutdown()
            thread.join()


def network_profile(port):
    return ("(version 1)(allow default)(deny network-outbound (remote ip))"
            f'(allow network-outbound (remote ip "localhost:{port}"))')

def derive_timings(evidence):
    # Account for up to 1 ms of WebKit clock quantization on each observation.
    samples = evidence["clock_before"] + evidence["clock_after"]
    low = max(before - page * 1_000_000 for before, page, _ in samples)
    high = min(after - page * 1_000_000 for _, page, after in samples)
    need(low <= high + 2_000_000, "host/page clock brackets disagree")
    low, high = low - 1_000_000, high + 1_000_000

    def host_bounds(page_ms):
        if page_ms is None:
            return None
        return [page_ms * 1_000_000 + low - 1_000_000,
                page_ms * 1_000_000 + high + 1_000_000]

        evidence["imposed_wait_ms"] = (released - arrived) / 1_000_000
        evidence["release_to_fetch_ipc_return_ms_bounds"] = delta(completion, released, released)
        evidence["release_to_ref_ready_ms_bounds"] = delta(readiness, released, released)

            evidence["row_observed_before_release_by_handoff"] = True
    elif arrived <= write_start and completion[0] >= write_end:
        evidence["overlap"] = "proved: complete write during pending fetch IPC"
    else:

def check_page(page, case, command):
    need(page["fetchError"] is None, f'fetch rejected: {page["fetchError"]}')
    if case != "control":
        report = page["fetchReport"]
        need(report and report["graph_error"] is None, f"invalid fetch report: {report}")

def wait_socket(directory, app):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 8
    while not (directory / "listening").is_file():
        need(app.poll() is None and time.monotonic() < deadline, "drive socket never became ready")
        time.sleep(0.025)


def native_sample(args, output, repo, remote, base, head, serial, case, incoming, summary):
    evidence = {
        "case": case, "serial": serial, "command": args.command if case != "control" else None,
        "release_mode": args.release, "incoming_oid": incoming,
        "settlement": "Unobservable. Git fetch IPC return and correct DOM endpoints are recorded.",
    }
    hold = case != "control" and args.release != "none"
    with local_remote(remote, hold=hold) as server, tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(
        prefix="t440d-", dir="/tmp"
    ) as private:
        directory = Path(private).resolve()
        data = directory / "data"
        data.mkdir()
        save(data / "trunk-prefs.json", {
            "column_visibility": {"diff": False, "sha": True},
            "tree_view_enabled": False, "fetch_interval_ms": 0,
        })
        git(repo, "remote", "set-url", "origin", server.url)
        evidence["before"] = snapshot(repo)
        evidence["remote_before_refs"] = refs(remote)
        need(evidence["before"]["porcelain"] == [], "dirty starting fixture")
        spec = {"repo": str(repo), "path": TARGET, "branch": BRANCH, "baseOid": head,
                "baseSummary": git(repo, "show", "-s", "--format=%s", "HEAD").decode().strip(),
                "incomingOid": incoming, "incomingSummary": summary}
        env = dict(environment(), TRUNK_DRIVE_DIR=str(directory), TRUNK_DATA_DIR=str(data))
        with (output / "app.log").open("wb") as log:
            app = subprocess.Popen([SANDBOX, "-p", network_profile(server.server_port), str(args.binary)],
                                   env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=log, stderr=log)
            watchdog = Timer(13, app.kill)
            watchdog.start()
            try:
                wait_socket(directory, app)
                evidence["startup"] = {}
                prepare_page(directory, spec, evidence["startup"])
                evidence["arm"] = install_observer(directory, spec)
                evidence["startup"]["baseline_graph_and_empty_staging_verified"] = True
                evidence["arm_receipt_ns"] = time.monotonic_ns()
                with measurement_window(output):
                    evidence["clock_before"] = clock_samples(directory)
                    if case != "control":
                        evaluate(directory, f'window.trunk440.start({json.dumps(args.command)})')
                        need(server.advertised.wait(DEADLINE), "no fetch advertisement reached the bare remote")
                    edit, started, finished = write_edit(repo, base, serial)
                    evidence["write_monotonic_ns"] = [started, finished]
                    evidence["expected_worktree_hex"] = edit.hex()
                    if hold and args.release == "row":
                        evidence["row_gate_receipt_ms"] = evaluate(directory, "window.trunk440.row()")
                    server.release()
                    expected = case if args.command == "git_fetch_background" and case != "control" else None
                    evidence["page"] = evaluate(directory, f"window.trunk440.result({json.dumps(expected)})")
                    evidence["clock_after"] = clock_samples(directory)

                check_page(evidence["page"], case, args.command)
                evidence["advertisement"] = server.advertisement
                evidence["barrier_release_ns"] = server.release_ns
                evidence["after"] = snapshot(repo)
                evidence["remote_after_refs"] = refs(remote)
                need(evidence["remote_before_refs"] == evidence["remote_after_refs"], "bare remote refs changed")
                need(not any("error" in entry for entry in server.requests), f"Git HTTP failed: {server.requests}")
                need(bool(server.requests) == (case != "control"), "unexpected control or fetch transport count")
                need(case != "changed" or any(r["method"] == "POST" for r in server.requests),
                     "new commit was not requested from Git HTTP backend")
                verify(evidence["before"], evidence["after"], edit, incoming)
                derive_timings(evidence)
                evidence["verdict"] = "passed"
            except BaseException as error:
                evidence["verdict"] = "inconclusive"
                evidence["error"] = str(error)
                server.release()
                if app.poll() is None and (directory / "listening").exists():
                    try:
                        evidence["partial_page"] = evaluate(directory, "window.trunk440?.read() ?? null")
                    except Exception as probe_error:
                        evidence["partial_page_error"] = str(probe_error)
                if "write_monotonic_ns" in evidence and "after" not in evidence:
                    evidence["after"] = snapshot(repo)
                raise
            finally:
                evidence["app_pid"] = app.pid
                evidence["http"] = server.requests
                evidence["advertisement"] = server.advertisement
                evidence["barrier_release_ns"] = server.release_ns
                try:
                    stop_app(app, lambda: request(directory, {"op": "quit"}))
                finally:
                    watchdog.cancel()
                    watchdog.join()
                    save(output / "sample.json", evidence)
    return evidence


def smoke():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="t440smoke-", dir="/tmp") as scratch:
        root = Path(scratch).resolve()
        repo, remote, base, head, _, _ = prepare(root, small=True)
        for serial, case in enumerate(CASES, 1):
            changed = case == "changed"
            incoming, _ = add_branch(repo, remote, serial, head) if changed else (None, None)
            before = snapshot(repo)
            with local_remote(remote, hold=case != "control") as server:
                if case == "control":
                    edit, _, _ = write_edit(repo, base, serial)
                else:
                    git(repo, "remote", "set-url", "origin", server.url)
                    with subprocess.Popen([SANDBOX, "-p", network_profile(server.server_port),
                                            GIT, "-C", str(repo), "fetch", "--all"],
                                           env=environment(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                           stderr=subprocess.PIPE) as fetch:
                        try:
                            need(server.advertised.wait(DEADLINE), "smoke fetch did not reach advertisement")
                            need(fetch.poll() is None and not server.released.is_set(), "fetch not held")
                            need(refs(repo) == before["refs"], "ref shown while response held")
                            edit, _, _ = write_edit(repo, base, serial)
                            need(fetch.poll() is None, "fetch finished before gate release")
                            server.release()
                            _, stderr = fetch.communicate(timeout=DEADLINE)
                            need(fetch.returncode == 0, f"Git smoke fetch failed: {stderr.decode()}")
                        finally:
                            server.release()
                            if fetch.poll() is None:
                                fetch.kill()
                verify(before, snapshot(repo), edit, incoming)
                need(not any("error" in entry for entry in server.requests), f"HTTP smoke failed: {server.requests}")
                need(bool(server.requests) == (case != "control"), "unexpected smoke HTTP count")
                if changed:
                    need(any(r["method"] == "POST" for r in server.requests), "no Git pack negotiation")
            (repo / TARGET).write_bytes(base)
            print(f"{case}: fixture, local Git transport, exact bytes/index/refs verified")
    print("No app launched and no performance samples recorded.")


def run(args):
    args.binary = args.binary.resolve(strict=True)
    args.output = args.output.resolve()
    need(args.output.is_relative_to(HERE), "output must be inside the ignored pilot directory")
    args.output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    order = list(CASES) if args.blocks == 1 else [
        *CASES, "unchanged", "changed", "control", "changed", "control", "unchanged",
    ]
    with Path("/tmp/trunk-native-diff-scroll.lock").open("a") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="t440i18-", dir="/tmp") as scratch:
            root = Path(scratch).resolve()
            repo, remote, base, head, count, source = prepare(root, args.small)
            witness = "src/d000/f00001.txt"
            def index_witness():
                disk = (repo / witness).stat()
                return {
                    "path": witness,
                    "inode": disk.st_ino,
                    "ctime_ns": disk.st_ctime_ns,
                    "mtime_ns": disk.st_mtime_ns,
                    "index": git(repo, "ls-files", "--debug", "--", witness).decode(),
                }
            entries = git(repo, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z")
            before = index_witness()
            if args.refresh_index:
                git(repo, "update-index", "--really-refresh")
            after = index_witness()
            need(entries == git(repo, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z"), "refresh changed a staged entry")
            if args.refresh_index:
                need(f"ino: {after['inode'] & 0xffffffff}\n" in after["index"], "witness inode did not refresh")
            save(args.output / "index-state.json", {
                "refresh": args.refresh_index, "before": before, "after": after,
                "staged_entry_sha256": hashlib.sha256(entries).hexdigest(),
            })
            def binary_identity():
                stat = args.binary.stat()
                return stat.st_dev, stat.st_ino, stat.st_size, stat.st_mtime_ns, stat.st_ctime_ns

            binary_stat = binary_identity()
            with args.binary.open("rb") as binary:
                binary_hash = hashlib.file_digest(binary, "sha256").hexdigest()
            save(args.output / "manifest.json", {
                "binary": str(args.binary), "sha256": binary_hash, "fixture_source": source,
                "files": count, "head_oid": head, "edit_path": TARGET, "order": order,
                "command": args.command, "release": args.release, "git": GIT,
                "git_version": git(root, "--version").decode().strip(),
                "script_sha256": {name: hashlib.sha256((HERE / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                                  for name in ("run.py", "repo_fixture.py", "observe.js")},
            })
            for serial, case in enumerate(order, 1):
                need(binary_identity() == binary_stat, "binary changed during the pilot")
                sample_dir = args.output / f"{serial:02d}-{case}"
                sample_dir.mkdir()
                incoming, summary = (None, None)
                if case == "changed":
                    incoming, summary = add_branch(repo, remote, serial, head)
                result = native_sample(args, sample_dir, repo, remote, base, head,
                                       serial, case, incoming, summary)
                (repo / TARGET).write_bytes(base)
                if incoming:
                    git(repo, "update-ref", "-d", TRACKING, incoming)
                    git(remote, "update-ref", "-d", f"refs/heads/{BRANCH}", incoming)
                print(json.dumps({"sample": sample_dir.name, "overlap": result["overlap"],
                                  "row_ms_bounds": result["write_to_correct_row_ms_bounds"]}), flush=True)
            need(binary_identity() == binary_stat, "binary changed during the last sample")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--fixture-smoke", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--small", action="store_true", help="use the 30-file E16-style fixture")
    parser.add_argument("--refresh-index", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--binary", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--blocks", type=int, choices=(1, 3), default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--command", choices=("git_fetch_background", "git_fetch"),
                        default="git_fetch_background")
    parser.add_argument("--release", choices=("write", "row", "none"), default="write")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.fixture_smoke:
        need(args.binary is None and args.output is None, "smoke does not launch a drive binary")
        smoke()
        return
    if not args.binary or not args.output:
        parser.error("native pilot requires --binary and --output")
    if args.blocks == 3 and args.release == "row":
        parser.error("row-held fairness is limited to one block")
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, lambda _signal, _frame: sys.exit(143))
    run(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
